title: Debug Session
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact. Output of auto-debugger. Proposes a bug-fix patch for a failed run, lists every variable the patch would touch, and provides evidence for the debugging decision. The variable-touch-guard reads touched_variables to decide BLOCK/PASS — the debugger never claims a fix is safe.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this debug session.

failed_run_ref.description: Reference to the failed run_record or triage_report that triggered this session.

summary.description: Human-readable description of the proposed fix.

files.description: Optional list of files the patch touches.

diff_hint.description: Optional diff hint or pseudocode for the patch.

touched_variables.description: Explicit list of experiment variables (from the experiment_matrix) this patch would touch. The variable-touch-guard reads this list. A patch touching no variables emits an empty array.

evidence_ref.description: Evidence references (triage_report, run_record, log excerpt) supporting the diagnosis. Anti-slop: at least one non-empty reference required.

root_cause.description: Optional root-cause hypothesis (prose, not a machine field).
